title: Not All Shocks Are Created Equal: Assessing Heterogeneity in the Bank Lending Channel
authors: Gil Nogueira; Luísa Farinha; Laura Blattner
eligible_reason: Not a staggered binary design. Each of three common event dates (PSI, OMT, QE) is analysed separately as a cross-section of 12-month changes (d_12, dead_12, flag_getrel, cag_12) on bank exposure share_exposure, a continuous bank-level exposure to sovereign debt, with bank and firm controls and absorbed FE (reghdfe ... if event == 'x'). Continuous treatment, common event dates, long-difference outcomes. Package data are BPLIM placeholder test files.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe/reg on credit-registry loan-level and bank-level data from Banco de Portugal (Portugal, 2011-2015 events). Heterogeneity by firm PD and bank characteristics via c.share_exposure##c.pd and share_exposure interactions.
data_files_note: README: data confidential at Banco de Portugal, replication through BPLIM. Shipped *_t.dta files are BPLIM test datasets: 1,000 rows each with placeholder integers (e.g. gina_capitalratio_bs = 999, gina_share_acceptrate = 747), not the original data.
screener_notes: Abstract from OpenAlex frame; no article text.
